executive_summary: The PMO requests a comprehensive Project Management Plan from the Lead Delivery Partner / Systems Integrator to establish baseline execution strategy, governance model, controls, resource allocations, and operational frameworks required to manage project execution through delivery, validation, and transition to operations on time, within approved budget, and in adherence to defined quality benchmarks.

required_subsidiary_plans.name: Scope Management & Baseline
required_subsidiary_plans.description: Work Breakdown Structure to Level 4/5 with WBS Dictionary; Scope Verification & Validation procedures; Integrated Change Control workflow and escalation protocols.

required_subsidiary_plans.name: Schedule Baseline & Milestone Management
required_subsidiary_plans.description: Critical Path Method schedule in Gantt format, milestone table of contractual/design/testing gates, Schedule Variance (SV) and Performance Index (SPI) monitoring cadences with baseline reset procedures.

required_subsidiary_plans.name: Cost Baseline & Financial Management
required_subsidiary_plans.description: Work package cost breakdown covering CapEx/OpEx and license fees; Earned Value Management metrics (PV, EV, AC, CV, CPI); Contingency reserves governance.

required_subsidiary_plans.name: Quality Management & Assurance (QA/QC)
required_subsidiary_plans.description: Defect severity classifications with TATs; Quality Gates for ARB, TRR, ORR; Audit schedules for internal and external compliance.

required_subsidiary_plans.name: Resource & Staffing Management
required_subsidiary_plans.description: Organizational Breakdown Structure, RACI matrix across milestones, Skill Matrix with qualifications, certifications, security clearances, and backup personnel commitments.

required_subsidiary_plans.name: Communications & Stakeholder Governance
required_subsidiary_plans.description: Stakeholder Register with influence/interest mapping; Governance meeting cadence (daily, weekly, bi‑weekly/monthly); Information radiators and dashboards for real‑time reporting.

required_subsidiary_plans.name: Risk, Issue & Opportunity Management
required_subsidiary_plans.description: Qualitative probability vs impact matrix, quantitative EMV/Monte Carlo analysis; Risk Register with owners and mitigation plans; Issue escalation ladder with SLOs.

required_subsidiary_plans.name: Procurement & Subcontractor Oversight
required_subsidiary_plans.description: Vendor inventory, procurement schedule for hardware/compute/license lead times, subcontractor quality audit criteria and performance tracking.

milestone_schedule.deliverable: Draft Project Management Plan (PMP) Initial Review
Final Approved PMP Baseline & Steering Committee Sign-off
Completion of Technical Discovery & WBS Dictionary Sign-off
Mid-Term Progress Review & Earned Value Assessment (EVM Gate 1)
Final Operational Transition, Handover Runbooks & Close-out Review

submission_requirements.traceability: Cross-reference table indicating exact sections where each RFP requirement and subsidiary plan is satisfied.
submission_requirements.sign_off_sheet: Dedicated signature page for Lead Project Manager, Delivery Director, Enterprise Architect, Client Steering Committee Lead.
